note: Panel recipe for tools/panelize.py. Tabs are given as a point near the board edge (single-board coordinates, mm, KiCad front view) and the outward direction; the tool finds the exact edge. The slot is 3.5 mm (not the usual 2 mm) because the coin-cell clip's closed end sticks out 3.07 mm past the right edge: it must hang over the slot, not over the frame. The supply track runs 0.3 mm from the left edge (y -14.6 to 1.8) and the cell track 0.3 mm from the right edge (y -19.7 to 2.8), so no tab sits on those stretches. No tab on the right edge: the cell track and then the clip's closed end occupy all of it below the switch.

tabs.why: top edge, left of the switch knob
top edge, right of the switch knob
left edge beside the switch, above the connector body
left edge, open side of the cell clip
bottom edge, left of the lower clip pad and clear of the clip body
